title: Hyperinterpolation beyond exact cubature: a spectral multiplier approach
summary: We study hyperinterpolation and its spectral multiplier variants on the sphere under weak cubature assumptions formulated through Sobolev discrepancy estimates. In contrast with classical hyperinterpolation theory, our framework does not require exact polynomial cubature formulas or Marcinkiewicz--Zygmund inequalities. The main idea is to interpret the discretization error as the action of a spectral multiplier operator on the cubature discrepancy measure.
